editorial:
Get ready for the ultimate hype machine before the main event kicks off. If you love the energy of a live crowd and the drama of professional wrestling, this kickoff show is exactly where you need to be. You get to see the experts break down the match-ups and hear the latest rumors that could change everything. It feels less like a movie and more like a giant party where everyone is waiting for the big stars to walk through the curtain. The vibe is electric, and it does a great job of getting your heart racing before the actual Royal Rumble matches begin.

What really works here is the pacing, as it moves quickly from analysis to high-energy matches. The action is loud and flashy, which is what you want from WWE. While it is just a warm-up show, the matches provide a good balance of skill and chaos. If you are a fan, you should definitely watch this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see every hit and facial expression clearly. If you prefer owning your gear, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for those long-term fans who love re-watching the history of the ring.
endingExplained: The kickoff ends by building maximum tension for the main event. After the opening matches finish and the analysts give their final predictions, the show transitions directly into the main Royal Rumble card. There is no huge twist here because it is a pre-show, but the final moments leave you hanging on a cliffhanger. It wraps up by promising that the biggest stars in the world are about to enter the ring for the legendary battle royale.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves pro wrestling and high-energy sports entertainment.
